accounting.note: table_bytes includes TOAST and its index; index_bytes excludes TOAST index. Column samples overlap physical storage and must not be added to relation totals.

samples.method: first bounded physical rows; not a random or representative production sample

limitations: No production connection or workload history was observed.
PostgreSQL statistics are estimates/cumulative since stats_reset; zero scans alone do not justify dropping an index.
Database, cluster directory, WAL files, dumps, Docker images and repository files are different storage scopes.
WAL counters cover the whole disposable cluster. They are not attributed to a single database.
The bounded inventory uses separate read-only transactions; concurrent writers may change values between samples.
